name: The Stave of Equinex
summary: At the Ruins of Ravenwind, Troyas Moonbreeze tests whether his stave can open the Equinex Monolith. You gather the essences of four flames still burning among the ruins.

sections.title: A Key for the Monolith
sections.body: Troyas Moonbreeze thinks his stave may be the Stave of Equinex, a key to the Equinex Monolith in the Ruins of Ravenwind. Four flames still burn there: Samha, Imbel, Byltan and Lahassa. Each yields an essence. You use all four at the monolith to energize the stave. If it is truly the key, the monolith will open and reveal a sacred artifact.

sections.title: At the Stone
sections.body: The energized stave is almost impossible to hold as its power rumbles through you. You reach for the monolith's cold surface, and a small door opens. Beams of light spill around the stone as you take what lies inside.

faq.q: Where is the Equinex Monolith located?
faq.answer: The Equinex Monolith stands in the Ruins of Ravenwind, west of the Dream Bough on the mainland.

faq.q: What are the four flames I need?
faq.answer: The four flames are Samha, Imbel, Byltan and Lahassa. They still burn in the Ruins of Ravenwind, and you gather the essence of each.

faq.q: What is the Stave of Equinex for?
faq.answer: Troyas Moonbreeze says the Stave of Equinex may be a key to the Equinex Monolith, which holds a sacred artifact.

faq.q: Where do I energize the stave?
faq.answer: You energize the stave beside the Equinex Monolith, using the essences of all four flames.
